text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's finally time, isn't it?
The autumn Tenno Sho, the showdown with Oguri-chan...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I won't just settle for a good run today.
My goal is—1st place. I fully intend to win~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well, you couldn't call yourself the ultimate villain
otherwise, could you?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's go for a sure victory.
Yeah, let's go for a sure victory.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've gone through every kind of training for this.
There are no regrets left...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, this is bad~!
I completely forgot one thing~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I haven't practiced talking like a villain at all.
This might not get very exciting at this rate.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Could I practice with you now,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, what a naughty child~♪ Daring to
defy me. Come now, down on your knees.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Say, 'I'm sorry, Lady Creek.'
If you do, I'll for-give-you...♪"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
R-Right.
Somehow, I'm starting to have a lot of fun, too...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this is definitely bad of me, isn't it?
If I win, I'll try to keep it a little more low-key~"
